title: Japanese Skirt Steak Kebabs
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring marinated skirt steak kebabs grilled to perfection.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, sugar, black pepper, and minced ginger.
2. Add the skirt steak to the marinade, turning to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
3. Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Thread the marinated skirt steak onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Brush the grill with flaky sea salt and Algerian olive oil to prevent sticking.
5. Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach your desired level of doneness.
6. Transfer the kebabs to a plate and sprinkle with fire-roasted sesame seeds.
7. Serve immediately, garnished with sliced green onions and a side of steamed vegetables.
